mapper.sql: n.note_id, n.author_id, n.question_id, n.content, n.like_count, n.comment_count, n.collect_count, n.created_at, n.updated_at, u.username AS author_name, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url, q.title AS question_title, q.difficulty AS question_difficulty
mapper.select: SELECT FROM notes n JOIN users u ON n.author_id = u.user_id JOIN questions q ON n.question_id = q.question_id WHERE n.note_id = #{noteId}
SELECT FROM notes n JOIN users u ON n.author_id = u.user_id JOIN questions q ON n.question_id = q.question_id WHERE n.note_id IN #{id}
SELECT FROM notes n JOIN users u ON n.author_id = u.user_id JOIN questions q ON n.question_id = q.question_id WHERE n.author_id = #{authorId} AND n.question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notes (author_id, question_id, content, search_vector) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{questionId}, #{content}, #{searchVector})
mapper.update: UPDATE notes SET content = #{content}, search_vector = #{searchVector} WHERE note_id = #{noteId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes WHERE author_id = #{authorId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes WHERE question_id = #{questionId}

SELECT note_id FROM note_collects WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND note_id IN #{id} UNION SELECT cn.note_id FROM collection_notes cn JOIN collections c ON cn.collection_id = c.collection_id WHERE c.creator_id = #{userId} AND cn.note_id IN #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT author_id) FROM notes WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes

SELECT FROM notes n JOIN users u ON n.author_id = u.user_id JOIN questions q ON n.question_id = q.question_id WHERE MATCH(n.search_vector) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) ORDER BY MATCH(n.search_vector) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) DESC, n.note_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes WHERE MATCH(search_vector) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE)

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, COUNT(*) AS day_count FROM notes WHERE author_id = #{authorId} AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY day

SELECT FROM notes n JOIN users u ON n.author_id = u.user_id JOIN questions q ON n.question_id = q.question_id ORDER BY (n.like_count * 2 + n.comment_count * 3 + n.collect_count * 2) DESC, n.created_at DESC, n.note_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT n.note_id, n.author_id, n.question_id, n.content, n.created_at, n.updated_at, u.username AS author_name, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url, q.title AS question_title, q.difficulty AS question_difficulty, COALESCE(s.like_count, 0) AS like_count, COALESCE(s.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count, COALESCE(s.collect_count, 0) AS collect_count FROM notes n JOIN users u ON n.author_id = u.user_id JOIN questions q ON n.question_id = q.question_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT note_id, SUM(like_count) AS like_count, SUM(comment_count) AS comment_count, SUM(collect_count) AS collect_count FROM note_daily_stats WHERE stat_date >= #{since} GROUP BY note_id ) s ON s.note_id = n.note_id ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.like_count, 0) * 2 + COALESCE(s.comment_count, 0) * 3 + COALESCE(s.collect_count, 0) * 2) DESC, n.created_at DESC, n.note_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS note_count, COALESCE(SUM(like_count), 0) AS like_count, COALESCE(SUM(comment_count), 0) AS comment_count, COALESCE(SUM(collect_count), 0) AS collect_count, COALESCE(SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(content)), 0) AS word_count FROM notes WHERE author_id = #{authorId}
SELECT DISTINCT DATE(created_at) FROM notes WHERE author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY DATE(created_at) DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes WHERE author_id = #{authorId} AND created_at >= #{since}
SELECT FROM notes n JOIN users u ON n.author_id = u.user_id JOIN questions q ON n.question_id = q.question_id WHERE n.author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY n.created_at ASC, n.note_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes WHERE content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{url}, '%')
SELECT content FROM notes
